Director Biographies Biographical and other information for our director nominees and continuing directors is provided below.
Betsy S. Atkins Chief Executive Officer and Founder, Baja Corporation
-  February 2009 to August 2009: Chair and Chief Executive Officer, Clear Standards (until acquired by SAP, AG)
-  1991 to 1993: Chair and Chief Executive Officer, NCI, Inc.
-  1989 to 1999: Co-founder, Director, Executive Vice President Sales, Marketing, International Operations, Ascend Communications (until acquired by Lucent Technologies)
-  Formerly Chair, Executive Advisory Board, SAP, AG, and Chair, Executive Advisory Board, British Telecom and presidential-appointee to the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation advisory committee

Ms. Atkins served as a director of NASDAQ, dealing closely with the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority, Inc. ("FINRA"), and as a member of the advisory board of the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation.
Ms. Atkins served as a director of Darden Restaurants, owner and operator of numerous restaurant chains.
Ms. Atkins served as Chair and Chief Executive Officer of NCI, Inc., and Chair and Chief Executive Officer of Clear Standards.
Ms. Atkins served as a director of SL Green Realty Corp., a fully integrated New York-focused public real estate investment trust from 2015 to 2024.
Craig S. Billings Chief Executive Officer, Wynn Resorts, Limited
-  2015 to 2018: Director and Non-Executive Chair, NYX Gaming Group
-  2012 to 2015: Chief Digital Officer, Strategy & Business Development Managing Director, various roles, Aristocrat Leisure Ltd.
-  Previously Vice President in the Investment Banking Division of Goldman Sachs, in both New York and London, covering the gaming industry

Mr. Billings has extensive leadership and innovation experience in the gaming industry, both domestically and internationally, as well as experience in the investment banking and financial services industries.
Mr. Billings serves as a director and chair of the compensation committee of Applovin Corporation, an AI-driven advertising technology leader.
Mr. Billings is the former CFO of Wynn Resorts, and previously served as a Vice President of Investment Banking at Goldman Sachs and an audit and assurance manager at Deloitte.
Mr. Billings is a member of the executive team that opened Encore Boston Harbor in 2019 and is overseeing the development of Wynn Al-Marjan Island.
